output: Hashing is one-way (passwords, Argon2/bcrypt); encryption reverses with keys (data at rest); encoding (base64) protects nothing.

instruction: Terangkan `cookies vs tokens sessions` dalam satu minit.
output: Cookies (`HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite`, auto-sent, CSRF risk!) vs tokens (manual headers, XSS risk!, mobile-friendly) vs sessions (server state, sticky/scale!) — cookies web (CSRF tokens!), tokens APIs/mobile (short-lived!), sessions simple (Redis-backed!).

instruction: Bila perlu guna `yaml indent anchors`?
output: YAML indent-scopes (spaces, never tabs!), `key:` maps, `- ` lists, `&a` anchors + `*a` aliases (DRY!), `|` literal vs `>` folded blocks — indent exact (silent misparse!), anchors reuse (no duplication!), linters validate (yamllint!).

instruction: Bila perlu guna `event sourcing cqrs`?
output: Events append-only (state rebuilt by replay!); snapshots bound replays; CQRS separates read/write models (projections!); upcasting migrates old events — history complete (audits free!), projections rebuilt (bug fixes!), versions handled (upcasters!).

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `k8s services ingress`.
output: ClusterIP (internal!) / NodePort (dev!) / LoadBalancer (cloud!) Services + Ingress (`ingressClassName`, TLS secrets, path rules!) — services stable endpoints (pods churn!), ingress routes (hosts/paths!), TLS terminated (cert-manager!).

instruction: When do I use `api deprecation headers`?
output: `Deprecation: true` + `Sunset: <date>` + `Link: <successor>; rel="successor-version"` + migration guides — deprecated discoverable (headers!), successors linked (machine-readable!), dates honored (removals on schedule!).

instruction: Bila perlu guna `xargs basics`?

instruction: Explain `http methods semantics` briefly.
output: GET (safe/idempotent reads!), POST (create/process!), PUT (full replace, idempotent!), PATCH (partial!), DELETE (idempotent removal!), HEAD/OPTIONS (metadata!) — methods semantic (caches/retries depend!), misuse breaks intermediaries!

instruction: What is `yamllint markdownlint codespell` for?

instruction: Bila perlu guna `health checks deep`?
output: Liveness (`/live`: process alive, restart if dead!) vs readiness (`/ready`: deps checked, removed from rotation!) vs startup (slow-boot grace!) — probes distinct (restart ≠ deroute!), deep enough (DB ping!), cheap enough (1s interval!).

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `REST CRUD mapping`?
output: POST collection creates, GET reads, PUT/PATCH updates, DELETE removes — predictable URLs beat clever ones.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `testing pyramid trophy`?
output: Pyramid (many unit, fewer integration, few e2e!) vs Trophy (static + integration-heavy!) — fast feedback (unit seconds!), confidence (e2e critical paths!), flakiness quarantined (quarantine suite!), coverage + mutation (MSI!).

instruction: Bila perlu guna `api deprecation headers`?
output: `Deprecation: true` + `Sunset: <date>` + `Link: <successor>; rel="successor-version"` + migration guides — deprecated discoverable (headers!), successors linked (machine-readable!), dates honored (removals on schedule!).

instruction: Bagaimanakah `rate limit headers retry` berfungsi?
output: `RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset` (IETF draft!) + `Retry-After` (seconds/date!) on 429; token-bucket vs fixed-window vs sliding (burst handling differs!) — limits communicated (headers!), 429 honored (backoff!), quotas tiered (plans!).

instruction: `YAML indent` untuk apa?
output: YAML nests by exact spaces (tabs forbidden!); quote `yes/no/on` strings that parsers coerce to booleans.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `cors preflight simple`?
output: Simple requests (GET/POST/HEAD + safelisted headers, no preflight!) vs preflighted (`OPTIONS` + `Access-Control-Request-*`, cached via `Max-Age`!); `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` exact (never `*` + credentials!) — CORS understood (browser-enforced!), origins whitelisted (reflected origins audited!).

instruction: Terangkan `k8s services ingress` dalam satu minit.
output: ClusterIP (internal!) / NodePort (dev!) / LoadBalancer (cloud!) Services + Ingress (`ingressClassName`, TLS secrets, path rules!) — services stable endpoints (pods churn!), ingress routes (hosts/paths!), TLS terminated (cert-manager!).

instruction: What is `mtls spiffe spire` for?
output: mTLS (client certs! `verify_peer`!) + SPIFFE IDs (`spiffe://trust/biz/svc`!) via SPIRE (attested issuance! rotation!) — identity cryptographic (no secrets!), attestation roots trust (TPM/k8s!), rotation automatic (short TTLs!).

instruction: When do I use `cdn cache headers s-maxage`?
output: `Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=3600, stale-while-revalidate=60` (CDN caches, background refresh!); `Vary` fragments correctly (Accept-Encoding only!); surrogate keys purge precisely — s-maxage CDNs (origin shielded!), stale-while-revalidate hides latency (freshness bounded!), vary minimal (explosion avoided!).

instruction: Bagaimanakah `CLI flags help` berfungsi?
output: `--help` documents, `-h` shortens, `--flag=value` configures; good CLIs fail with usage on misuse.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `tcp handshake backlog`?
output: SYN → SYN-ACK → ACK (1.5 RTT!); backlog (`somaxconn`, `tcp_max_syn_backlog`!) drops bursts; `TIME-WAIT` reuse (`tw_reuse`!) — handshakes counted (SYN floods!), backlogs sized (drops monitored!), keepalive reuses (handshakes avoided!).

instruction: Terangkan `lazygit lazydocker bottom` secara ringkas.

instruction: How do I use sed to replace text?
output: `sed 's/old/new/g' file` prints the result with all occurrences replaced. Use `-i` to edit in place (`sed -i 's/old/new/g' file`; on macOS use `-i ''`). Use another delimiter for paths: `sed 's|/a|/b|g'`.

instruction: What is `CLI flags help` for?
output: `--help` documents, `-h` shortens, `--flag=value` configures; good CLIs fail with usage on misuse.

instruction: What is `2pc saga outbox` for?
output: 2PC (prepare+commit, blocking coordinator = availability risk!) vs Saga (compensating local txns!) vs transactional outbox (atomic insert + relay!) — 2PC avoided (blocking!), sagas compensate (idempotent steps!), outbox relays (dedupe consumers!).

instruction: Explain `readme badges shields` briefly.

instruction: What is `auth schemes bearer basic` for?
output: Bearer tokens (`Authorization: Bearer`, opaque/JWT!), Basic (base64, HTTPS only!), Digest (challenge-response, legacy!), Mutual TLS (client certs!), `WWW-Authenticate` challenges — schemes matched (Bearer APIs!, mTLS zero-trust!), credentials rotated (leak windows!).

instruction: What problem does `url parsing pitfalls` solve?
output: Parse (`new URL`, punycode/IDNA!); trailing-dot FQDNs; `@` userinfo confusion (`https://evil@real`!); `..` normalization bypasses; `javascript:` scheme blocklist — parsers standard (regexes bypassed!), userinfo rejected (unexpected!), schemes allowlisted (not blocklisted!).

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `owasp ssrf xss csrf`.
output: A10 SSRF (metadata blocked! allowlists!); XSS-reflected/stored/DOM (contexts encoded! CSP! Trusted Types!); CSRF (SameSite + tokens! GET never mutates!) — trinity tested (payloads!), headers set (CSP/CSRF!), contexts distinguished (encoders per sink!).

instruction: Apakah fungsi `backups 321 rule test`?
output: 3 copies + 2 media + 1 offsite (immutable!) + tested restores (fire drills quarterly!) + RTO/RPO defined (business signed!) — rule followed (audited!), restores tested (Schrödinger otherwise!), RTO measured (assumptions die!).

instruction: How do I debug a hanging process with strace?
output: Attach with `sudo strace -p PID -f` to watch its system calls, or start a command under it with `strace -f -tt -e trace=network,file cmd`. A process stuck in `read`, `futex` or `connect` points to what it is waiting for. Use `-c` for a summary of time per syscall, and check `/proc/PID/stack` and `wchan` for processes in D (uninterruptible) state.

instruction: How would you explain `http status codes map` to a junior developer?

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `HTTP status 5xx`.

instruction: Terangkan `graphql vs rest pick` secara ringkas.
output: GraphQL (client-shaped queries, single endpoint, N+1 risk + complexity limits!) vs REST (cacheable, simple, over/under-fetch!) — GraphQL for varied clients (mobile!), REST for CRUD simplicity (caching!), persisted queries harden GraphQL!

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `screen detach reattach`?
output: `screen -S job` + `Ctrl-A d` detach + `screen -r` resume (`-x` multi-display!); `-S` names (listable!), logging (`-L`) — screen everywhere (minimal installs!), tmux richer (choose per host!).

instruction: Give a practical example of `timeout deadline budget`.
output: Timeouts per hop (connect/read/total!) + deadlines propagate (`grpc-timeout`!) + budgets (`p99 < 500ms` end-to-end allocated per hop!) — timeouts everywhere (no infinite hangs!), deadlines propagate (slowest hop bounded!), budgets enforced (SLOs!).

instruction: Bagaimanakah `tls certificates chain` berfungsi?
output: Leaf + intermediates + root chain (served complete! `openssl s_client -showcerts` verifies!); SANs list names (CN deprecated!); OCSP stapling (revocation live!); expiry monitored (30-day alerts!) — chains complete (missing intermediate = broken!), SANs exact (mismatches reject!), rotation rehearsed.

instruction: Apakah fungsi `vpn wireguard tailscale`?
output: WireGuard (`AllowedIPs` cryptokey-routing! roaming seamless!) self-hosted mesh; Tailscale ACLs (`autogroups/tagOwners`!) managed — cryptokey routes (no firewall rules!), ACLs default-deny (explicit allows!), exit nodes approved (egress logged!).

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `source vs bash`.
output: `source script.sh` runs in current shell (functions/vars persist); `bash script.sh` isolates — choose by intent, not habit.

instruction: Explain `sharding keys hotspot` briefly.
output: Shard by high-cardinality key (user_id!); hotspots resharded (celebrity problem!); cross-shard queries avoided (scatter-gather slow!); directory vs hash vs range mapped — keys even (measured!), hotspots split (monitored!), transactions single-shard (2PC avoided!).

instruction: What does `interview system design` do?
output: Requirements (functional + scale!) → estimates (QPS/storage/bandwidth!) → API → data model → high-level (LB/app/cache/DB/queue!) → deep-dives (hotspots!) → trade-offs stated — scoped first (ambiguity clarified!), numbers estimated (back-of-envelope!), trade-offs explicit (no perfect!).

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `cqrs read models rebuild`.
output: Write model (commands validated!) vs read models (denormalized per query! rebuilt from events!); `last_processed_position` tracks; blue-green projections (swap verified!) — models separated (writes vs reads!), rebuilds routine (bugs fixed!), positions tracked (resumable!).

instruction: Terangkan `http methods semantics` secara ringkas.
output: GET (safe/idempotent reads!), POST (create/process!), PUT (full replace, idempotent!), PATCH (partial!), DELETE (idempotent removal!), HEAD/OPTIONS (metadata!) — methods semantic (caches/retries depend!), misuse breaks intermediaries!

instruction: `regex dot star` untuk apa?
output: `.` any char, `*` zero-or-more (greedy), `^...$` anchors full matches — validate, then extract with groups.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `resume star stories`.
output: STAR (Situation/Task/Action/Result quantified!) + 1-page + keywords matched (ATS!) + GitHub alive (commits!) — quantified results (numbers!), tailored per role (keywords!), projects demonstrated (live links!).

instruction: When do I use `dependency audit sbom`?
output: `npm audit`/`pip audit`/`osv-scanner` (CI gates critical!), SBOMs generated (customers ask!), `dependabot` PRs (merged promptly!) — audits scheduled (weekly!), SBOMs published (regulations!), updates batched (minor auto, major planned!).

instruction: What is `dig short trace` for?
output: `dig +short` answers cleanly for scripts; `+trace` walks delegation from roots when DNS lies.

instruction: Explain `circuit breaker states` briefly.
